Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Supersonic's step-goal picker - a stack of goal cards ("Walk in the park" 7,500 to "I'm insane" 15,000 steps) where selection bursts thematic emojis and the card bounces into its highlighted state.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Purple screen, "Set daily step goal" title with a hint line. Four cards stacked: Walk in the park (7,500 steps), Ramp it up (10,000), Bring the heat (12,500), I'm insane (15,000) - each with a thematic emoji left and the step count right. Unselected cards are dark purple; the selected card turns white with dark text.

## Motion spec
Pattern: emoji-burst selection with bouncy card state change.
- Tap a card: it flips to the selected white style with a springy scale bounce (1.0 to 1.04 to 1.0, spring ~420/20) while the previous selection deflates back to dark (200ms).
- On selection, a burst of 6-10 copies of the card's emoji pops from the card's left icon: they arc outward with random velocities, spin, fade, and die within ~700ms.
- The card's emoji icon does its own quick spin (rotate 360deg, 300ms) as the burst fires.
- Cards idle with a faint stagger float (translateY +-2px, phase-offset) - barely-there life.
- Selection changes can be spammed; each tap re-triggers bounce and burst cleanly.

## Calibration
- The burst is one shot per selection, not a loop - confetti that won't stop is noise.
- White selected state must flip text and count colors with it; partial recolor reads as broken.

## Reduced motion
Selection recolors without bounce or burst.

## Don't miss
- Each goal's emoji matches its intensity (park tree to flames to skull) - the escalation is the joke.
- The step counts stay visible and right-aligned through every state change.
